evidence.quote: A speciﬁc example might be the Nb-Ta system because Nb and Ta are chemically quite similar, so that the interaction energy parameter may be small; this is consistent with experimental observations [ 30] that the yield strengths of Nb-Ta alloys do not show any signiﬁcant increase over the strengths of elemental Nb and Ta.

One mode of advance of the dislocation is forward advance of an entire (average) 2.5ζc segment from its initial low-energy state, over the adjacent higher-energy state, and into the subsequent low-energy state further along the glide plane. This mechanism is operative if it requires a lower stress than that for lateral kink glide (evaluated below).
Under stress, the kinks that are formed spontaneously to minimize the total dislocation energy can glide laterally across the total straight segments of average length 2.5ζc.
Strengthening due to the existence of cross-kinks is caused by the need for the dislocation to break the cross-kinks so that overall glide of the dislocation line can continue.
